ideas.name: Heating Oil Roll Spread Effect
ideas.claim: The paper reports that heating oil futures calendar spreads decreased on the day after a commodity index fund rolled a long position from the nearby contract into a deferred contract.
ideas.quote: The estimated parameter is 0.0131 which suggests that on days following rolls (sell nearby, buy deferred) the spreads decrease by 0.0131 percent.

rules.market: NYMEX heating oil futures, nearby and next active contracts
rules.timeframe: Daily; effect measured on the day following a roll
rules.filters: Fund roll transaction selling the nearby contract and buying a deferred contract

ideas.claimed_result: The estimated spread change following a roll was -0.0131%; the paper reports this coefficient as statistically significant at the 5% level. The position-data sample ran from February 2007 through May 2012.
required_data: Daily prices for individual nearby and deferred NYMEX heating oil futures contracts
Daily commodity index fund roll transactions
